requirements.text: Implement the smallest deterministic research-only readout that summarizes existing sensor-family relationship evidence using the canonical relationship vocabulary, distinguishes historical from prospective evidence and exposes presentation roles for double-count prevention without changing weights or market semantics.
Known related sensor/test families are represented using only canonical relationship classes with exact source/test IDs and evidence class/sample status.
Presentation roles PRIMARY/VALIDATION/AUDIT_ONLY/DATA_BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED are clearly non-weighting metadata and preserve unresolved states.
Low Pearson/Spearman correlation alone cannot produce UNIQUE.
No sensor is removed, promoted, reweighted or counted as independent confirmation by this readout.

scripts/experiments directly related read-only sensor relationship/compression helper | tests/experiments directly related relationship compression tests | 06_RESEARCH_LAB directly related generated current relationship/compression artifact

evidence: PR #1271 merged at ddd8e92178292e0aad98a6aad7159c5658d8bc8e after Experiment Lifecycle, Data Architecture, Automation Production Health and Storage Health gates passed.

Independent focused relationship-compression fixtures passed 6/6, including low-linear-correlation NOT UNIQUE, semantic duplicate REDUNDANT/AUDIT_ONLY, DATA_BLOCKED fail-closed, duplicate-group count-once metadata and zero authority/weight invariants.

Current readout was materialized from the exact then-current Experiment Lifecycle registry with 54 prospective sensor-combination rows, 7 semantic duplicate groups and 2 explicit historical proxy rows; historical rows remain current_prospective_validation=false.

Generated readout authority is research-only/non-binding with canonical_market_state=false, market_gate_change=false, model_weight_change=false, portfolio_action=false and no automatic sensor promotion/retirement.
